name: Wild salmon fry
description: Newly seaward-migrated juvenile salmon of wild origin, mostly pink and chum salmon, during roughly their first 120 days in the Sound. Life-stage group pooled by the source (wild fry were tracked separately from hatchery releases); they feed on zooplankton, preferring calanoid copepods. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
